Steering a neural world model

Set an intended movement. The model predicts what a neural population would do in response, then decodes that prediction back into motion — the forward model running in the open, one step at a time.

  1. 1The interactive model is trained on a synthetic linear spiking system, so its numbers describe that system and no brain.
  2. 2The browser runs the same forward pass as the Python model: measured max |Δ| 3 × 10⁻⁵ against a 2 × 10⁻³ gate.
  3. 3Playback runs at roughly one fifth of model time.
